findings.proof: Dedupe shares ONE adapter promise (hence one error object, one error.config) between N identical concurrent GETs; each caller's interceptor increments the SAME cfg.__rlRetries. Simulation with real axios 1.20.0 + the two repo modules (scratchpad/adv/sim.mjs): one single 429 then 200 -> N=3: 0 rejected; N=5: 1 rejected; N=6: 2; N=8: 4 rejected (callers 5+ get the 429 error and the global 'Trop de requetes' toast although the limiter has only refused ONE call).
findings.fix: Count retries per caller, not on the shared cfg: clone cfg per retry ({...cfg, __rlRetries: attempt+1}) or key the counter on a per-call WeakMap; add a Vitest case with dedupe+retry and 8 concurrent GETs.

findings.proof: Site 'validation de commande' is NOT driven through the UI: the test calls window.LC.api.placeOrder() directly with a fabricated cart {id:501}. D03 PNG is the home hero ('SERVICE FERME - OUVRE DANS 2 H 31'), not a checkout. Only waveA A2b proves the header for origin localhost:8011, not www.lecayenne.fr.

findings.proof: B03: the round trash button sits on the top-right corner of the '+' button. From CSS: overlap 28x28=784 px2 = 60% of the trash bbox; centre of '+' is 3.9 px OUTSIDE the trash circle and the glyph's corner is under it, trash is z-above. A tap slightly up-right of '+' deletes the line (removeItemDirectly, :694) instead of adding one. Pre-existing code, newly visible in evidence.
findings.fix: Move the trash out of the stepper (own row / left of the line, >=12 px gap) or drop the absolute offset.

findings.proof: No bail-out on a long Retry-After: a 3600 s lock waits min(30 s)x4 = ~2 min of silent frozen UI before the toast, whereas site api.js bails out when ra>60 (api.js plafondAttente). Inconsistent; module header claims a real block is never hidden but it is delayed 2 min.
findings.fix: If Retry-After > MAX_WAIT_MS*2 (or body.retry_after>60) reject immediately.

findings.where: round-2/waveB/B01 network.json (401 kiosk-event, 401 frontend/menu, 401 GET /api/login) ; all console.json 429 entries
findings.proof: Un-allowlisted 4xx at kiosk boot (pre-login race, no alert) and 429 console errors (injected, retried silently). Protocol letter = cat 6/10 P0; needs an explicit written allowlist (injected-429 + boot 401) or the gate stays red.
findings.fix: Add 'injected 429 retried silently (controls B06/C03 prove the instrument)' and the boot-401 to the protocol allowlist; or fix boot order.
